title: 我的家
description: A young student named Xiao Ming introduces his family and their daily life at home.

sentences.translation: My name is Xiao Ming.
My family has four people.
Dad is a doctor.
Mom is very beautiful.
I have a cat.
My cat is very small.
We eat at home.
The food mom cooks is very delicious.
Dad watches TV.
I read books and study Chinese.
We are all very happy.

title: 在饭店
description: Xiao Ming and his friend Xiao Hong go out for lunch and enjoy a delicious meal together.

sentences.translation: Today at noon I really want to eat.
I make a phone call to ask my friend Xiao Hong.
Xiao Hong says OK, let's go to the restaurant.
The restaurant is in front of the school.
The restaurant is very big and there are many people inside.
We sit on the chairs.
There are many dishes here.
I want to eat rice and some dishes.
Xiao Hong wants to drink tea, not water.
I drink water and also tea.
The food arrived — so delicious!
We eat rice, drink tea, and are very happy.
The fruit here is also very delicious.
How much do all these things cost?
We are very happy and say goodbye.

title: 买东西
description: Xiao Ming's mother takes him shopping for new clothes and fruit at the market.

chapters.title: 去商店
chapters.titlePinyin: Qù Shāngdiàn — Going to the Shop

sentences.translation: Today mom wants to go to the shop to buy things.
She asks me to come along.
The shop is not behind our home — it is in front.
We take a taxi to go there.
The shop is very big and has many things inside.
Mom looks at some clothes.
That piece of clothing is very beautiful.
How much does this piece of clothing cost?
One hundred yuan.
Mom bought that piece of clothing.
I see a lot of fruit.
There are apples and many other kinds of fruit.
I like eating apples.
Mom bought a lot of apples.
We went home, very happy.

title: 我的一天
description: Follow Xiao Ming through a full day — from waking up in the morning to going to bed at night.

sentences.translation: In the morning I get up at seven o'clock.
Mom makes breakfast.
I drink water and eat an apple.
Dad has gone to work.
I also go to school.
In the morning I study Chinese.
The teacher speaks Chinese; I listen and write characters.
At noon I eat lunch with my classmates.
In the afternoon I read books and write characters.
I like studying Chinese very much.
At five in the afternoon, I returned home.
We eat dinner at home.
The meal mom cooks is very delicious.
Dad watches TV; I read books.
I go to sleep at nine o'clock.

title: 过生日
description: Today is Xiao Ming's birthday. Friends come to celebrate and everyone has a wonderful time.

sentences.translation: Today is my birthday!
I am eight years old this year.
Dad and mom say: Happy birthday!
I am very happy.
Today friends are coming to my home!
At three in the afternoon, my friends came.
They brought many things.
We eat a lot of delicious things.
There are fruits and apples — extremely delicious!
Everyone is very happy.
I wish to go to China next year.
I want to learn many Chinese characters.
Friends say: we also want to go!
Today is a very good day.
Thank you, friends!

title: 周末旅游
description: Li Hua and her husband plan a weekend trip to Beijing and experience the excitement of travelling.

sentences.translation: Let's travel to Beijing this weekend!
Husband says: Great, I'm already ready.
We take the plane because it is faster than the train.
I bought two tickets online.
We are extremely happy.
At six in the morning we arrived at the airport.
There are many people inside the airport.
We first look for our boarding gate.
The plane departs at nine — we must not be late.
We boarded the plane, extremely excited!

chapters.title: 到了北京
chapters.titlePinyin: Dào Le Běijīng — Arriving in Beijing

sentences.translation: We arrived in Beijing!
Beijing is much bigger than the place we live.
We stay at a hotel.
The room is very big and also very nice.
Tomorrow we plan to visit many places.

title: 在公司
description: Wang Fang describes a typical busy workday at her company, from commute to after-work plans.

chapters.title: 上班路上
chapters.titlePinyin: Shàngbān Lùshang — On the Way to Work

sentences.translation: Every day I get up at seven o'clock in the morning.
First I wash my face, then eat breakfast.
The company is not far from my home — it is very near.
I ride my bicycle to work.
Riding a bicycle is very fast — it only takes ten minutes.

chapters.title: 工作很忙
chapters.titlePinyin: Gōngzuò Hěn Máng — Very Busy at Work

sentences.translation: I work at a big company.
Today work is extremely busy.
I have many questions to answer.
My colleague tells me: if there are problems, just ask me.
Although very busy, I feel very happy.
At six in the afternoon I finished work.
I am very tired and want to rest for a bit.
A friend asks me: shall we go eat together?
I say OK, let's eat at the nearby restaurant.
We eat together, chat, and are very happy.

title: 我的爱好
description: Chen Lei shares his favourite hobbies — sport, music, and reading — and why they make him happy.

sentences.translation: I love sport very much.
Every morning I go running.
I ran for half an hour.
On weekends I play soccer together with friends.
Exercise is extremely good for the body.

chapters.title: 音乐和唱歌
chapters.titlePinyin: Yīnyuè hé Chànggē — Music and Singing

sentences.translation: I also like music very much.
Every day I listen to music, and sometimes I also sing.
I feel that singing makes me very happy.
My older sister also likes singing; she sings very well.
Singing together is truly very happy.

chapters.title: 看书和写日记
chapters.titlePinyin: Kàn Shū hé Xiě Rìjì — Reading and Writing a Diary

sentences.translation: My other hobby is reading books.
I like reading Chinese books because I can learn many new characters.
Every evening I write in my diary.
I write down the events of today.
I hope my Chinese gets better and better in the future.

title: 生病了
description: Xiao Li wakes up feeling unwell, visits the doctor, and learns to take better care of her health.

sentences.translation: This morning I am not feeling well.
My head hurts a lot and I have a fever.
Mom is very worried and tells me to go to the hospital.
I also feel I should go see a doctor.
We take the bus to the hospital.
The doctor asks me: where do you feel unwell?
I tell the doctor I have a headache and a fever.
The doctor briefly examines me.
He says: you are sick, you need more rest.
The doctor gives me some medicine and tells me to go home and rest.
Once I returned home, I immediately took my medicine.
Mom made me hot water and noodles.
I slept and rested for a whole day.
The next day, I felt much better.
In the future I must take good care of my health.

title: 在学校
description: A student shares what it is like to study Chinese at school and introduces a new friend.

sentences.translation: I am a student.
I study Chinese at school.
The teacher is very good.
I have books and a computer.
Chinese is great — I really like it.
I have a good friend.
His name is David.
He is also a student.
We both study Chinese.
David speaks Chinese very well.
We are good friends.
